headline: Short-period S junk at a marginal angle — dawn log session or skip it.
today: Waist- to chest-high but it's 4-second S mush hitting the beach at a bad angle, so don't expect much shape. The one window is dawn to mid-morning while the wind is W and light-glassy; once the S onshore fills in around midday it's over. Log or groveler, ride the morning around that 8:48 low, keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the run at 2-3ft but still short-period S at a marginal angle with cross-on wind all day — bigger, not better.
WSW wind 11-14mph on it from dawn, and the angle's still marginal. Junky.
Cross-off morning wind but the swell drops under 1.5ft — clean and basically flat.
